written.headline: HCLTech and Cohere partner to build sovereign AI solutions
written.summary: HCLTech and Cohere have partnered to build and deliver sovereign artificial intelligence solutions for enterprises and governments in Canada and Germany. The initial development targets insurance, financial services, and manufacturing.

written.headline: Google signs $500M+ geothermal power deal with Quaise Energy in Oregon
written.summary: Google signed a deal valued at over $500 million to secure 50 megawatts of geothermal power from Quaise Energy's Project Obsidian in Oregon. The carbon-free energy will support Google's data centers in the state starting as early as 2030.
